profile.title: Director of Engineering | AI & Ads Measurement Leader
profile.headline: Bridging computer science research with enterprise commercial scale.
profile.summary: I lead engineering organizations that bridge foundational computer science with large-scale commercial impact. At LinkedIn, as Director of Engineering leading Ads Measurement, I direct a 40–70+ person full-stack organization across Audience, Identity, Incrementality, Recommendations, and Measurement charters. I built LinkedIn's Brand Advertising business from the ground up to over $1 billion in annual revenue (~20% of total ad revenue) and led engineering for our AI advertising suite, scaling it 6x to $100M ARR in six months. I hold a PhD in Computer Science, graduated summa cum laude with a master's in systems engineering, served as an associate professor and deputy vice-rector, and hold three issued U.S. patents.

doctrine.title: Bayesian Causal Inference & Account-Based Marketing
doctrine.quote: Heuristic last-touch models misallocate significant capital toward organic converters. In our systems, we isolate selection bias from true ad intervention using Bayesian incrementality and company-level audience splits.
doctrine.narrative: In advertising, correlation is not causation. If an advertiser was going to buy anyway, claiming attribution for that conversion is an illusion. I architected our incrementality systems to measure true economic causality across 25% of LinkedIn's total advertising revenue. By deploying Bayesian modeling, company-level audience splitting, and frequency-aware sampling, we measure genuine incremental impact for enterprise advertisers with rigorous statistical confidence.

doctrine.title: Differential Privacy & Privacy-Safe Signal Consolidation
doctrine.quote: In advertising, as in physics: if your measurement instruments distort what they observe, your conclusions are worthless. We extract signal from noise while preserving mathematical privacy.
doctrine.narrative: Regulatory and platform privacy shifts require robust cross-entity analytics without exposing raw personal data. I directed the comprehensive overhaul of LinkedIn's outcomes infrastructure, unifying Conversions API (CAPI) with privacy-preserving cryptographic computation and differential privacy techniques on a next-generation attribution platform. We enforce strict mathematical privacy guarantees while preserving the statistical utility of conversion signals.

doctrine.title: Scaled Identity Graph & Pairwise Multi-Source Resolution
doctrine.quote: An advertising platform is only as coherent as its understanding of identity. By resolving fragmented signals into a unified graph, you turn disconnected events into actionable enterprise intelligence.
doctrine.narrative: Modern measurement and targeting collapse when identity is fractured across devices, browsers, and enterprise ecosystems. I directed the architecture of our identity graph infrastructure that ingests and resolves pairwise observations from both first-party platform signals and third-party data providers at scale. By reconciling deterministic and probabilistic link graphs within privacy-safe enclaves, our platform establishes high-fidelity entity resolution that powers accurate audience targeting, frequency governance, and robust causal attribution across the entire monetization ecosystem.
